---
title: "Tools & Reports"
description: "Reusable dashboards, templates, automated reports, research tools, and workflow resources."
---

Tools & Reports collects reusable materials that make analysis easier to inspect, repeat, or adapt: dashboards, templates, automated reports, classification systems, scraper workflows, research tools, and documentation patterns.

## Reusable Resources

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Report Bundle Runners

Linux and R wrappers for rendering recurring report bundles, routing outputs to a data lake, refreshing artifacts, and scheduling supported report types.

**Status:** In active use  
**Materials:** Render scripts, report templates, artifact folders, schedule notes
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Title Classification Exports

Structured classification outputs for stream and video titles, with modular definitions, talent overlays, validation checks, archived runs, and current exports for report joins.

**Status:** In active use  
**Materials:** DuckDB tables, prompt definitions, batch runs, CSV exports
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Qualitative Coding Review Files

Batch-built transcript coding runs with candidate rows, compiled codebooks, review CSVs, QA summaries, apply previews, and logs.

**Status:** In active use  
**Materials:** Codebooks, transcript prep files, review exports, QA summaries
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Data Lake Movement Scripts

Push, pull, clean staging, and refresh workflows that keep scraped data, creator analytics, and report contexts organized across local workspaces and a data lake.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Scraper and Public Signal Workflows

Reusable import and analysis scripts for public media sources such as Anime News Network, AniList, gacha trend sources, YouTube topic searches, and billboard references.
:::
::::
